t2.thesis: AMZN enters the print with strong AWS momentum, upward EPS revisions and a depressed forward P/E, giving a slight edge over the base rate, but the implied move of about 8% means the outcome is close to a coin flip with a modest positive skew.
reasons: Last quarter's AWS growth of 37% was the fastest in 18 quarters, and Q3 expectations are for further acceleration (I4, I9, I21)
EPS estimates have been revised up about 2% over 90 days, and the stock is 11% below its 52-week high with a forward P/E near its five-year low (I2, I11)
The last four prints had a 75% win rate, with three strong positive reactions, but this is a small sample and the bar is now higher after the +13.6% move
The implied move is high at about 8%, and heavy capex with negative free cash flow is a risk to the reaction (I1, I4, I14)
t2.deciding_variable: AWS growth and backlog versus expectations, together with the 2026 capex guide and the free cash flow trajectory.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 0.542; AMC session 0.538; consumer cluster 0.555

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Amazon's earnings report on 2026-10-29 is after my knowledge cutoff (and, per today's date, hasn't happened yet), so I have no information on how the stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up about 2 points from 0.54 to 0.56 on estimate revisions, AWS momentum and valuation; limited by elevated expectations after the +13.6% prior reaction and capex/FCF concerns.

theses.expected: Rise on AWS acceleration above 37% and a strong backlog
theses.mechanism: AI demand is validated, and the market rewards cloud growth that outpaces capex worries
theses.wrong_if: AWS growth decelerates or comes in at or below consensus

theses.expected: Fall on a capex increase and weak free cash flow
theses.mechanism: Investors penalize spending without matching revenue, given the TTM free cash flow outflow
theses.wrong_if: Capex guidance is stable and operating cash flow growth stays strong

theses.expected: Muted or mixed reaction driven by Q4 guidance
theses.mechanism: The retail operating income guide range sets the tone, and a high bar after the last jump leaves little room
theses.wrong_if: The Q4 guide is clearly above consensus, producing a large gap up

key_observations: AWS revenue growth rate and operating margin
Backlog size (~$496B) and Trainium and Anthropic/OpenAI commitments
Advertising growth versus the 26% in Q2
Anthropic mark-to-market gains in other income, which should be excluded from EPS quality assessment
